name: Surana Telecom and Power Limited
about: Surana Telecom and Power Limited engages in the generation of renewable energy in India. The company operates through Renewable Energy (Solar & Wind); and Trading & Others segments. It is involved in the trading of solar related products; wind power generation; and infrastructure leasing. The company also provides cable, solar photovoltaic, aluminum rods, jelly filled cables, CDMA mobile handsets, and optic cable and accessories, as well as heat shrinkable jointing kits. It owns a total installed capacity of 15 MW. The company was formerly known as Surana Telecom Ltd and changed its name to Surana Telecom and Power Limited in October 2007. Surana Telecom and Power Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
